locator: pp.353–357 §The Soul’s Independence from Body, especially p.355
interpretation: Pasnau accepts the logical form of the first argument but disputes the certainty of its premises. In particular, the sensory comparisons do not establish an analogous cognitive limit for a brain-based intellect. His p.356–357 content/constitution objection addresses the subsequent universal-concept argument, which is not silently identified with this cognitive-range argument.
